t.COCAMIDOPROPYL_BETAINE.agn: It is not in the annexes of the EU Cosmetics Regulation; there is no specific limit or labelling rule.
t.COCAMIDOPROPYL_BETAINE.eff.0: Residues from manufacturing (DMAPA and amidoamine) may cause contact allergy. CIR found it safe when formulated to be non-sensitising.
t.COCAMIDOPROPYL_BETAINE.summary: A mild cleanser derived from coconut oil fatty acids.
t.COCAMIDOPROPYL_BETAINE.what: Boosts foam, cleans and adjusts the product's viscosity; it is used together with harsher cleansers.
